This page lists appearances of the ''Star Wars'' CCG on general gaming podcasts and YouTube shows outside the game's own community shows, including interviews with Decipher designers and staff and with Players Committee members. For the community's own shows see [[Podcasts, video and interviews]]; for Decipher's shows see [[Radio Free Decipher]] and [[WARS Radio]].
